subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox adopt and support `cloud-run-sandbox` as a built-in provider while Google Cloud Run sandboxes and the required operator gateway are public-preview surfaces?
rationale: The patch is technically substantial and has credible live proof, but only maintainers can choose the long-term support, compatibility, and security-boundary contract for this new provider.

options.title: Sponsor as experimental built-in
options.body: Accept the provider with clear preview and operator-gateway support boundaries, then remove the release-owned changelog entry before merge.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it with an invitation to revisit when Cloud Run sandbox APIs and the gateway contract are ready for a supported core surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor as experimental built-in
recommendation.body: Accept the provider with clear preview and operator-gateway support boundaries, then remove the release-owned changelog entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent provider trust-boundary work makes them the strongest available routing candidate for the gateway security contract, though repository history could not be fully re-read in this environment.
